title: OT-CAL: Optimal-Transport-Guided Adaptive Sample Selection for Efficient Visual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.41677v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep neural networks for image recognition are typically trained using mini-batches, with a forward pass to compute predictions and losses followed by a more computationally expensive backward pass to update model parameters. However, not all training samples contribute equally to learning, suggesting that computation can be reduced by performing backward passes only on informative samples. The challenge is that sample informativeness changes throughout training: difficult samples may be valuable early on, improving samples become important later, and class diversity becomes increasingly relevant toward the end. Existing methods often rely on fixed selection rules or computationally expensive per-sample gradient calculations. We propose OT-CAL, an adaptive data selection method that automatically adjusts its sampling preferences during training. translated_title: OT-CAL：面向高效视觉学习的最优传输引导自适应样本选择
translated_abstract: 用于图像识别的深度神经网络通常采用小批量方式训练，先通过前向传播计算预测结果和损失，再通过计算开销更大的反向传播来更新模型参数。然而，并非所有训练样本对学习的贡献都相同，这表明可以只对信息丰富的样本执行反向传播，从而减少计算量。挑战在于样本的信息价值在训练过程中不断变化：困难样本在训练早期可能很有价值，正在改善的样本在后期变得重要，而类别多样性在训练末段变得越来越重要。现有方法通常依赖固定的选择规则或计算代价高昂的逐样本梯度计算。我们提出OT-CAL，一种自适应数据选择方法，能够在训练过程中自动调整其采样偏好。OT-CAL使用五个信息量特征来表示每个样本，包括难度、学习改善程度等。（原文摘要于此处截断）
tldr: OT-CAL提出了一种基于最优传输的自适应样本选择方法，通过五个信息量特征在训练各阶段动态调整采样偏好，仅对信息丰富的样本执行反向传播，从而显著降低视觉模型训练的计算成本。
en_tdlr: OT-CAL is an optimal-transport-guided adaptive data selection method that leverages five informativeness features to dynamically adjust sampling preferences throughout training, reducing computational cost by performing backward passes only on informative samples.
